# @surfaces-ui/pipelines

Reference pipeline runner for Surfaces UI: builds datasets from one another on an Engine, with data quality rules.

The reference pipeline runner: builds datasets from one another on an engine, in dependency order, with row rules and checks over what was built. Runs only definitions a person approved.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/pipelines
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.
